caption: The drawing depicts a single object, a hand saw, positioned horizontally across the center of a plain, off-white background. The saw consists of a rusty, dark brown metal frame that forms a squared "C" shape, with one straight edge at the bottom that holds the toothed metal blade. The blade is attached to the frame and extends horizontally. To the right side of the frame, there is a detailed wood-textured handle, rendered in light brown, with a curving, ergonomic shape that has an upward-facing decorative notch and a small lower guard. The saw's handle is attached to the frame by two visible screws. At the bottom center of the image, in small text, is the name "EDWARD UNGER." There are no additional objects or features in the composition.
title: Saw
